name: Malayan Banking Berhad
summary: Malayan Banking Bhd. operates as a holding company. The firm engages in the provision of commercial banking and related financial services through Group Community Financial Services, Group Corporate Banking and Global Markets, Group Investment Banking, Group Asset Management, and Group Insurance and Takaful segments. The company was founded on May 31, 1960 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
